title: Yellowed Velvety Croatian Beef Pasta
description: A roasted Croatian dish featuring lean minced beef and a velvety pasta water emulsion, served in a bento box.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the pasta according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the minced beef and cook until it is browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the grated carrots, beef broth, tomato paste, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the cooked pasta and continue to simmer for an additional 2 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a bento box and serve hot.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
